description: The Line Entertainment, aims to push the boundaries from both a practical and creative perspective for every IP.

children: Built on our heritage of creating original short films, we're extremely proud to now have a top-notch, dedicated team focused on developing and producing our own IPs. These range from long-form content like features and series to games and comics - while still funding shorts, where it all started.
